tasks.title: Choose a Net Revenue Retention Design
tasks.context: Leadership wants a recurring-revenue KPI for the existing customer base.
tasks.goal: Include expansion and losses while excluding new-customer revenue.
tasks.expectedAnswer: (Starting recurring revenue + expansion - contraction - lost revenue) divided by starting recurring revenue
tasks.explanation: NRR isolates how the starting recurring-revenue base changes over time.
